meta.note: Synthetic runs of the simulator, same seed with and without each change. Educational comparison, not a prediction. "People still there when the fire front arrived" counts synthetic people at home at that moment; it is not a casualty count.

variants.widen: pavement widened to 20 ft clear plus 8 ft per side parked today (standards().fireCode), parking posted to those sides, lanes unchanged (assumption)
variants.noParking: no parking on the pinch only (red curb)

measures.engineNotReached5: synthetic Berkeley hill residents (area: those behind the pinch) whose street no engine reaches within 5 minutes at ignition under the seed's parked cars
measures.engineNoRoute: same, with no engine route at all
measures.fireFrontHome: synthetic people behind the pinch still at home when the fire front reached their street
measures.vehFireFront: vehicles from behind the pinch on a street when the fire front reached it
measures.vehNoRoute: vehicles from behind the pinch on the road at the end with no route to safety
measures.vehNotOut: vehicles from behind the pinch that set off but never left the area behind it (cut off)
measures.clearP90: minutes from the first order until 90% of the evacuating vehicles from behind the pinch had left that area; null if never
measures.sharedLanes: two-way segments left with one lane between parked cars
measures.vehiclesNoRoute: all vehicles on the road at the end with no route to safety
measures.fireFrontPeople: all synthetic people at home or on the road when the fire front reached them
